# YashVardhan Gupta

> Personal portfolio, blog and learning log of YashVardhan Gupta, a software and systems engineer from India. He builds robotics-style simulation and lab-automation tools (ROS 2, MCAP, 3D digital twins), real-time and trading infrastructure, machine learning and full-stack products, and takes on internships and freelance work. Site: https://yashvardhangupta.com/

- Name: YashVardhan Gupta (also written Yash Vardhan Gupta, Yashvardhan Gupta; GitHub handle yashvardhancse)
- Current role: Quantitative Developer, Researcher & Trader at a Dubai & Singapore based trading firm
- Also: Founder & Project Admin of QuantNova (https://quantnova.in), a quantitative backtesting platform; Founder & Ride Lead of the Manipal Riders Club
- Focus areas: quantitative finance, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, market making, low-latency systems, Python, C++, Rust, CUDA, machine learning, full-stack development
- Contact: yashvardhancse@gmail.com

## Projects
- [LabTwin](https://yashvardhangupta.com/projects/labtwin/) (case study): a ROS 2 + browser digital twin of a nanolitre sample-prep robot — protocol validation, deterministic 3-axis simulation in 3D, and MCAP record/replay that opens in Foxglove, backed by a real rclpy ROS 2 package. Live demo: https://labtwin.pages.dev — Source: https://github.com/yashvardhancse/labtwin
- [Pashu Saathi - AI Livestock Analyzer](https://github.com/yashvardhancse/Pashu-Saathi-AI-Livestock-Analyser-Mobile-Application-SIH-2025-PS-25005-): Flutter mobile app for livestock analysis and health monitoring (SIH 2025 internal round qualifier)
- [OrbitIQ - ISRO GNSS Satellite Modeling](https://github.com/yashvardhancse/OrbitIQ-ISRO-GNSS-Satellite-Clock-Orbit-Error-Modelling-SIH-2025-PS-25176-): satellite clock and orbit error modeling for an ISRO problem statement (SIH 2025 internal round qualifier)
